name: Rear Three Quarter Wide Stance Pool
name_es: Rear Three Quarter Wide Stance Pool
pose_description: Exact pose: rear three-quarter view, wide balanced stance, hips shifted with a clear S-curve, torso slightly rotated, one arm reaching forward away from camera, the other arm extended back, weight distributed on both legs. Camera placed 3 meters behind her and slightly to her left, at hip-to-waist height, angled just a few degrees upward, pointing at her lower back and the shifted hip, with the forward arm leaving the frame toward the front. 85mm lens, f/2.8, focus on her back, waist and hip line, luxury pool and palm trees in front of her, harsh tropical sunlight, ultra detailed
